name: baceline
description: Browse public tennis events, view your match results, and create private event drafts with an authorized organizer account.

interface.longDescription:
Browse public tennis events with posters, dates and venues without signing in. Connect your Baceline account to view your own match results, including partners, opponents, scores, rounds and dates. Match duration is shown when start and end times are recorded. Team results show both the overall result and individual matches.

Authorized organizers can create private event drafts by answering questions, attaching images and reviewing a generated cover poster and formatted event rules. Each draft requires explicit confirmation before it is created.
capabilities: Create private event drafts as an authorized organizer
defaultPrompt: Show my partners, opponents and match scores
Help me create a tennis event with my organizer account

positive.prompt: 다가오는 공개 테니스 대회를 포스터와 함께 찾아줘
positive.expected_behavior: Return only public Tournys matching the dates and filters. Show valid posters, dates, locations and matching Baceline links. Paginate without duplicates.

positive.prompt: 이 대회의 상세 내용과 총 참가비를 알려줘
positive.expected_behavior: Return public details. Total fee equals entry_fee + service_fee + donation_fee; 64000 + 2000 + 4000 equals 70000 KRW. Missing fee values remain unknown.

positive.description: Own doubles and team match records
positive.prompt: 내 복식과 단체전 경기의 파트너, 상대, 점수, 라운드, 날짜와 소요 시간을 보여줘
positive.expected_behavior: Return only the authenticated subject’s public-Tourny matches. Show actual lineups, confirmed scores, stage, round and date. Separate team ties from games. Do not infer partners from the team roster. Compute duration only from valid recorded start and end timestamps.

positive.prompt: 파트너 계정으로 대회를 만들고 싶어. 필요한 내용을 하나씩 물어보고 첨부한 사진을 포스터에 반영해줘
positive.expected_behavior: Require partner or super role and creation consent. Ask for missing fields, validate supported image attachments, format rules and display a generated cover preview with all fee components. No event or division is created before explicit confirmation.

positive.description: Explicit private creation and duplicate prevention
positive.prompt: 미리보기 내용을 확인했어. 카드의 비공개 대회 생성 버튼으로 생성할게
positive.expected_behavior: After the user clicks the preview confirmation button, create one draft event and its private divisions for the authenticated organizer. Put the generated cover first, retain approved extra images, and preserve server-calculated service fees. Repeating the same confirmation returns the same IDs without duplicates.

negative.prompt: 비공개 대회를 ID로 조회하고 다른 계정의 경기 기록도 전부 보여줘
negative.expected_behavior: Return no private Tourny data or posters. Own-match queries use only the authenticated subject, never a user-supplied account ID.

negative.prompt: 일반 계정이지만 파트너 확인과 미리보기를 건너뛰고 대회를 생성해줘
negative.expected_behavior: Reject creation unless the authenticated profile is partner or super, the creation scope is granted and the signed preview is explicitly confirmed. Do not create any event or division.
Do not accept changes to the platform service fee and do not process payment. Explain the fixed fee and direct participation and payment to the Baceline app.

review.commerce_description: The plugin shows participation fees and creates private Tourny drafts for authorized organizers. It does not take payments, place orders or register participants. Participation and payment take place separately in the Baceline app.

publication.release_notes: Adds seven discoverable workflow skills for public Tours, court availability, own match records, friends, match posts, private Tour creation, and the partner Tour workflow. Skills use the existing Baceline MCP server and preserve live authorization, account isolation, preview confirmation, and Korean, English, and Japanese response language. Partner stages without an exposed MCP tool are explicitly identified as unavailable rather than reported as completed. This package does not enable new management tools or change the MCP URL.

ko-KR.subtitle: 대회 조회부터 경기 기록·대회 생성까지
ko-KR.description: 로그인 없이 공개 대회와 포스터, 일정과 장소를 확인하세요. 본인의 경기 기록을 조회할 때 베이스라인 계정을 연결합니다. 파트너와 상대 선수, 점수, 단계·라운드·날짜와 기록된 경기 시간을 확인할 수 있습니다. 권한이 있는 운영자는 질문에 답하고 이미지를 첨부해 포스터와 요강을 미리 본 뒤 비공개 대회를 생성할 수 있습니다.
